title: Pod Salt Nexus Strawberry Kiwi Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Strawberry Kiwi Ice Nic Salt blends ripe, juicy Strawberries with the exotic tang of Kiwi, lifted by a cool icy layer. The Strawberry note is sweet and summery, while the Kiwi introduces a sharper, tropical edge. A streak of Ice rounds off the profile, adding a brisk chill that lifts both flavours to fresh and flavoursome new heights. This Nic Salt is mixed at 50VG/50PG, perfectly suited for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod systems, vape pens, and starter kits. The nicotine salt formula ensures fast nicotine absorption with a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, producing discreet vapour and consistent flavour. As with every Pod Salt Nexus flavour, Strawberry Kiwi Ice is crafted in the UK to exacting standards. It reflects the range’s focus on inventive blends that balance fruit clarity with reliable performance.
